module: Flowgraph node "Get Multiple Buttons" (category repeat_instant): watches several previously created buttons. For each i (number set in the properties, 'Button Ids'): input "buttonId_i" (number), outputs "clicked_i" (pulse) and "buttonId_i" (number, the output with the same name as the input).
notes: The output pin buttonId_i is never written by work(); only 'clicked_i' is updated.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the node's state from the saved data.

_onSerialize.desc: Writes the node's state to the save table.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the editor's custom properties panel; returns a string describing the change (for the undo history) or nil.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central area of the node in the flowgraph editor.

builder.desc: Editor node builder (builder:Middle() opens the central area).

style.desc: Node display style provided by the editor.

updatePins.desc: Adjusts the number of triplets (input buttonId_i, outputs clicked_i and buttonId_i) by removing extra links and pins or creating the new ones.

work.desc: For each i, reads the button buttonId_i and copies button.clicked to "clicked_i".
